title: Fintech Platforms and Mutual Fund Distribution
authors: Claire Yurong Hong; Xiaomeng Lu; Jun Pan
near_miss_reason: A staggered binary treatment exists (dtop2or = fund available for sale on the Tiantian or Ant platform in quarter t; funds join at fund-specific quarters; fund FE nsymbol + quarter FE time; Table 3 header 'Staggered Entrance onto Platform and Flow-Performance Sensitivity'), but every reported column adds (i) time-varying controls logsize and logage, (ii) the lagged outcome flow_1, and (iii) the performance indicator decile10 (or dtop10/dtop1030/dtop3050 ranks) interacted with dtop2or. The paper's coefficient of interest is the interaction (flow-performance sensitivity), not the ATT of platform entry. Half of the columns also omit fund FE (a(time) only).
eligible_reason: No reported column is a plain TWFE/event-study regression of an outcome on the binary platform-entry indicator: all include lagged flow, time-varying fund controls and treatment-by-performance interactions, and the object of interest is a heterogeneity coefficient (subgroup-by-treatment interaction), which PROTOCOL Section 2 excludes.
design_notes: Fund-quarter panel of Chinese actively managed equity (nstyle==2) and mixed (nstyle==3) funds, 2008-2017 (and 2011-2014 windows). Table 3 (stata code.do lines 6-20): reghdfe flow decile10 dtop2or dtop2or_decile10 logsize logage flow_1, a(time) or a(nsymbol time), cluster(nsymbol time). Table 4: rank bins dtop10/dtop1030/dtop3050 and their dtop2or interactions. Table 5 horse-race of performance horizons (horserace.dta). Table 6 family-level (family.dta). Table 7 retail vs institutional flows. Table 8 volatility outcomes (flowperfstd.dta). Table 9 holding-period returns with a(nstyle time). Data dictionary: dtop2or = 'dummy variable that equals one if a fund is available for sale via Tiantian or Ant platforms for quarter t'.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Fund-specific platform entry quarters (F_BEGIN_DATE in Wind Cmfsellingagents); platforms launched 2012; not counted from the data in this screen.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (logsize, logage), lagged outcome flow_1, and decile10 + dtop2or_decile10 interaction; coefficient of interest is the interaction
specs.treatment_definition: fund available on Tiantian or Ant platform in quarter t (staggered fund-level entry)
specs.notes: Columns 4 (2008-2017), 6 and 8 (mixed funds) analogous at lines 12, 16, 20; odd columns use a(time) only.

ineligible_specs.reason: rank-bin x platform interactions, controls, lagged flow
horse-race / family / flow-type / volatility / return specs, all with controls, lagged flow and interactions; Table 9 has no fund FE

data_files_note: Analysis files built from Wind/CSMAR are shipped in Stata and SAS formats; README describes them as the datasets submitted with the final manuscript (no mention of disguising).
software_detail: Stata (reghdfe, outreg) for Tables 3-9; SAS for Tables 1-2, 6 and figure data; Python for figures
priority_note: Near-miss: staggered binary platform-entry indicator exists, but no reported column estimates its ATT without controls, lagged flow and performance interactions.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Borderline classification: recorded as eligible_design=true / near_miss=true because dtop2or is a staggered absorbing binary regressor with fund and quarter FE, but note that stripping controls and interactions would change the research question (flow-performance sensitivity), so the lead may prefer to treat this as eligible_design=false.
eligible_design_note: set to false Nov 1 ~22:05 (coding rule, PROTOCOL 5b): near-miss with no main-text specification satisfying every design rule
